main.OID: skip: constant -1 in every row (GIS export artefact, not an identifier)
main.LINE_ID: table:seg — numeric line id, shown per segment
main.LINE_NAME: chart-seg, chart-kind, insight:longest, insight:split, insight:shortest, table:seg — segment name; names containing Extension are classed as extensions
main.YEAR: kpi:year, insight:horizon, table:seg — planning target year (2050 for every segment in the current file)
main.Shape_Length: chart-seg, chart-kind, kpi:length, kpi:main, insight:longest, insight:split, insight:shortest, insight:rounding, table:seg — measured length in metres (ITM), shown in km
main.LENGT: insight:rounding, table:seg — the same length rounded to whole km; fallback when Shape_Length is missing
resource:8689afdd-6df5-4610-9f3d-9c36ad3: skip: XLSX metadata sheet (publisher, contact, field list), not data rows and not a twin of the CSV
